description: Find real decisions of Georgian courts on an issue: case number, court, date, exact snippet and link when stored. get_coverage lists the courts held; pass court to search one of them only. Read a decision with get_court_decision before you describe it. With status none_found, say in one line that no published decision was found in the collections held, up to decisions_through, and that this does not mean none exists. სასამართლო პრაქტიკა: რეალური გადაწყვეტილებები, საქმის ნომერი, თარიღი.

court.description: Optional: search only the Supreme Court (supreme) or only the Constitutional Court (constitutional).
court.title: Court

query.description: What to look for, best in Georgian legal terms, e.g. 'სააპელაციო საჩივრის ვადა'.
query.title: Query
